ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can learn a decade of forecasting experience overnight, but scientists remain responsible for deciding whether a storm warrants a red alert.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows that about 9,400 atmospheric and space scientists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 9,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 100 jobs, with roughly 700 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $97,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace atmospheric and space scientists, but it will change how research is conducted. AI forecasting, data assimilation, and accelerated models make computation much faster, shifting scientists' time toward physical modeling, interpretation, and decision review. Understanding atmospheric physics and translating results into decision guidance remain difficult to replace.
ai_s2_accel: AI and machine-learning forecast models
AI-accelerated data assimilation
Intelligent optimization of climate-model parameterizations
Intelligent identification and warning of extreme weather
ai_s2_auto: Automated quality control and organization of observational data
Automatic generation of data visualizations and charts
Assisted drafting of reports and papers
Automated output for routine forecasting workflows
ai_s3_list: Physical modeling and scientific intuition: AI learns correlations, while people must understand physical mechanisms.
Result interpretation and uncertainty judgment: understanding why model outputs behave unexpectedly.
Decision responsibility: people remain accountable for issuing warnings and approving launch windows.
Interdisciplinary collaboration: communicating effectively with weather operations, aerospace, and emergency departments.
Long-term scientific judgment: slow variables such as climate change require human foresight.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means a substantial share of the work involves data and computation, areas where AI is strong, resulting in moderately high exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Faster AI computation increases the need for scientists to assure quality and explain results. Purely computational roles that only run models face pressure, while scientists who understand physics and accept decision responsibility become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong undergraduate foundations in mathematics, physics, and programming before specializing in atmospheric science. Professionals who combine machine learning with Earth-system modeling are especially scarce in the AI era, and graduate education is generally necessary.

Use AI forecasting and intelligent assimilation tools, and move beyond writing code and running models toward research design and decision review. The intersection of AI and Earth systems is a leading growth area.

People with quantitative or computing backgrounds can enter through data analysis or climate services. A resume that specifies models used, dataset scale, and decisions supported is more useful than a long course list.

When hiring scientists, test both physical understanding and computational ability by asking candidates to explain the causes of a model result. Candidates who use AI, translate it into operations, and accept decision responsibility deserve investment.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Identify severe convection and heavy rain

ai_s7_trends: AI forecasting and machine learning become standard operational tools integrated with numerical models.
Climate adaptation and extreme-weather prevention drive public and commercial demand.
Growth in space weather and the aerospace industry increases demand for space-science talent.

body: Atmospheric and space scientists study atmospheric processes, weather systems, climate change, and space environments through observation, numerical simulation, and data analysis, producing weather forecasts, climate predictions, and space-weather monitoring.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能在一夜之间学会十年的预报经验，但「这场雨该不该发红色预警」的责任，还是科学家来担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年大气与空间科学家在岗约 0.94 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.95 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.07 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.74 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代大气与空间科学家，但会改写研究方式。AI 预报、资料同化和模式加速让计算环节大幅提速，科学家的时间转向物理建模、结果解释和决策把关。真正难以替代的，是对大气物理的理解和把结果变成决策建议的能力。
ai_s2_accel: AI 机器学习预报模型
资料同化的 AI 加速
气候模式参数化的智能优化
极端天气的智能识别与预警
ai_s2_auto: 观测资料的自动化质控与整理
数据可视化与图表的自动生成
报告与论文初稿的辅助生成
常规预报流程的自动化输出
ai_s3_list: 物理建模与科学直觉：AI 学到的是相关性，物理机制要人来把握。
结果解释与不确定性判断：模式结果反常时，知道为什么。
决策责任：预警发不发、发射窗口行不行，责任在人。
跨学科协作：跟气象业务、航天、应急部门把话讲通。
长期科学判断：气候变化这种慢变量，需要人的远见。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业有相当一部分工作在数据和计算端——这正是 AI 的强项，所以曝光分偏高。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：AI 把计算提得越快，越需要科学家把关质量和解释结果。被压缩的是只跑模式、不做判断的纯计算岗，懂物理、能担责的科学家更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 本科打好数学、物理和编程底子，再走大气科学方向。AI 时代会机器学习、会地球系统建模的交叉人才最稀缺，读到硕士以上才够用。
把 AI 预报和智能同化工具用起来，从「写代码跑模式」升级到「设计研究 + 把关决策」。往 AI 与地球系统交叉方向走，是当前最热增量。
有数理或计算背景的，可从数据分析、气候服务方向切入。简历上写「用过什么模式、处理过多大资料、给什么决策提供过依据」，比堆课程更有用。
招科学家要考「物理理解 + 计算能力」：给一个模式结果让他解释成因。会 AI、能落地业务、敢担决策责任的候选人最值得投入。

ai_s7_trends: AI 预报与机器学习成为业务标配，与数值模式融合发展。
气候变化应对与极端天气防范带动公共与商业需求。
太空天气与航天产业扩张，空间科学方向人才需求上升。

body: 大气与空间科学家研究大气过程、天气系统、气候变化与空间环境，通过观测、数值模拟与数据分析，开展天气预报、气候预测与太空天气监测。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能在一夜之间学会十年的预报经验，但「这场雨该不该发红色预警」的责任，还是科学家来担。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Layout software can calculate quantities, but masons still decide how to place each brick and maintain a steady hand.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 74,100 brickmasons and blockmasons were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 76,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,300 jobs, with approximately 5,600 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $60,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Brickmasons And Blockmasons, but it will reduce standardized work. Layout and quantity software accelerates planning, shifting work from repeated measurement toward masonry feel, irregular shapes, and on-site repairs. People limited to standard walls face displacement, while skilled masons who handle custom forms become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Vertical-alignment assistance
Process recommendations
Progress tracking
Loss optimization
ai_s3_list: Masonry feel: people maintain stability.
Irregular forms: experience guides the work.
On-site repairs: people make the tradeoffs.
Quality control: people rely on a trained eye.
Process coordination: people make teamwork work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this occupation in the relatively low AI-exposure range. Layout and quantity calculations are accelerated, while masonry and hands-on feel remain firmly human.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not mean no change. Standard-wall work is being replaced, not skilled custom masonry. People with steady hands who can handle irregular shapes become scarcer as prefabrication expands. Those limited to standard square walls face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start as an apprentice and practice masonry feel and irregular forms. Standard-wall work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop craftsmanship early.
Advance from standard masonry to irregular forms and repairs, and learn layout software.
Emphasize craftsmanship and projects, and identify the structures you have worked on.
Do not select workers only for speed; assess whether their hands are steady and their walls remain straight. Skilled core workers merit higher daily pay.

ai_s7_trends: Prefabricated construction becomes widespread.
Digital layout.
Strong craftsmanship is in greater demand.

body: Brickmasons And Blockmasons build brick and block walls from drawings, use guide lines to maintain plumb and level surfaces, and finish joints and edges to protect structural strength and appearance.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代砖工，但会压缩标准环节。放线与算量软件把排版提速，工作从「反复量」挪向「砌筑手感、异形处理、现场修补」。真正被挤掉的是只砌标准墙的人，手艺好会异形的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 垂直度辅助
工艺推荐
进度跟踪
损耗优化
ai_s3_list: 砌筑手感：稳靠人。
异形处理：经验靠人。
现场修补：取舍靠人。
质量把关：眼力靠人。
工序协调：配合靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光区——放线算量被加速，但砌筑与手感仍牢牢在人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化：被替代的是「标准墙」砌筑，不是「手艺与异形」的岗位。手稳会异形的人，反而随装配更稀缺。怕的是只会砌标准方墙。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学徒起步多练手感与异形，AI 时代纯标准墙在缩，早点练手艺。
从「砌标准」升级成「异形 + 修补」，学放线软件。
突出手艺与项目，写清跟过哪些结构。
选人别只看快，要看手稳不会歪。手艺骨干值得给高日薪。

ai_s7_trends: 预制装配普及。
放线数字化。
手艺好更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: RegTech can run watchlists and rules automatically, but Compliance officers still decide whether to report, explain exceptions, and accept responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 418,000 Compliance officers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 430,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 12,300 jobs, with about 33,300 openings per year. The 2026 median annual wage is about $78,400 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Compliance officers, but it will accelerate monitoring and reporting. RegTech speeds up watchlist screening, rule matching, and report generation. Compliance officers shift from checking transactions one by one to risk judgment, contextual communication, regulatory engagement, and accountability. Basic screening becomes faster, while people who exercise sound judgment and communicate clearly become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted risk classification
Automated regulatory text analysis
Faster anomaly clustering
Training material generation
ai_s3_list: Risk judgment: people decide whether to report.
Contextual communication: people explain exceptions.
Regulatory engagement: people choose how to communicate.
Accountability: people accept responsibility.
Rule implementation: people integrate controls into the business.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this career in the moderate-high exposure range for monitoring work. Systems accelerate basic screening, while people retain judgment and accountability.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Technology replaces transaction-by-transaction matching and standard forms, not risk judgment or regulatory engagement. People with judgment and communication skills become scarcer as productivity rises. Roles limited to following rules face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with a bachelor's degree in law or finance, and study regulation and RegTech while in school. Pure screening work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop judgment and communication early.
Move from checking watchlists to making judgments and engaging regulators. Learn RegTech and work toward becoming a compliance officer with broader responsibility.
Highlight qualifications and real compliance experience, including the regulatory areas you have worked in. Employers value integrity and reliability.
Do not evaluate candidates on attention to detail alone. Test whether they can make defensible judgments. People who can engage regulators justify premium pay.

ai_s7_trends: RegTech raises productivity and reduces basic roles.
Tighter regulation increases demand.
Compliance officers who can make judgments and engage regulators face stronger demand.

body: Compliance officers monitor regulatory and internal-control risks in business activities. They check sanctions and adverse watchlists, handle suspicious transaction reports and regulatory communication, and conduct training and audits to keep institutions operating within regulatory frameworks.
career_ai_description_block.heading: RegTech can run watchlists and rules automatically, but Compliance officers still decide whether to report, explain exceptions, and accept responsibility.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 监管科技能自动跑名单和规则，但该不该报、怎么解释例外、出了事谁担，还是合规专员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年合规专员在岗约 41.80 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 43.03 万人，净增约 1.23 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.33 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.84 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代合规专员，但会加速监测与报送。监管科技把名单筛查、规则比对、报告生成提速，合规专员从「逐笔核」挪向「风险判断、情境沟通、监管对接、兜底责任」。真正被提速的是基础筛查，能判断会沟通的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助风险分级
监管文本自动读
异常聚类提速
培训材料生成
ai_s3_list: 风险判断：该报不该报靠人。
情境沟通：例外怎么解靠人。
监管对接：话怎么说靠人。
兜底责任：谁担责靠人。
规则落地：怎么嵌业务靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的监测区——基础筛查被系统加速，但判断与责任还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「逐笔比对、出标准表」的动作，不是「判断风险、对接监管」的岗位。有判断力和沟通力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会照规则跑的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 法律/金融本科打底，在校多读监管与 RegTech。AI 时代纯筛查在缩，早点练判断和沟通。
从「核名单」升级成「做判断 + 对接监管」，学监管科技，争取当合规官。
突出资质和真实合规经验，写清跟过哪些监管条线。企业看重原则和稳。
选人别只看细心，要看会不会判断。能对接监管的，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: RegTech 提效，基础岗缩。
监管趋严，需求增。
会判断对接的合规官更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can clearly list what each major leads to and how much it pays, but only a counselor in the room can hear what lies behind a student's fear whenever science subjects come up.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 376,300 counselors worked in education in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 389,600 by 2034, a net gain of about 13,300 jobs, with about 31,000 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $65,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI is narrowing the information gap in education and career planning. Students and parents can search major databases, career matches, salary data, and subject-selection advice themselves. Yet counseling is about self-understanding and choice. Determining what suits a student, what drives their anxiety, and how to reconcile family expectations with the student's wishes requires trust and professional judgment. AI provides data, but not direction or empathy.
ai_s2_accel: AI career-matching engines that provide initial suggestions
Automated answers to common education questions
Employment dashboards that inform course content
Remote counseling platforms that reach more students
ai_s2_auto: Data tools that assist college application matching
ai_s3_list: Individual understanding: insight beyond assessment results.
Trust: helping students voice what they truly think.
Family communication: reconciling parental expectations with a student's wishes.
Integrated judgment: combining data, personality, and context.
Continued follow-up: guidance and adjustment after a choice.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure range. AI is taking over much of the information and matching work, but individual understanding, trust, and guidance through decisions remain central. AI can present the options, but it cannot know the person or accompany them through a decision. Jobs will shift from providing information to deeper counseling.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate risk still means change. Counselors who only recite major lists and employment data face replacement by AI. Counselors who use data tools and understand psychology and communication become more valuable because they provide deeper service. Treat AI as the researcher and yourself as the counselor.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For a student considering this career, education or psychology is a useful major. Build experience in counseling and career development while in school. Parents should also keep planning in perspective: it is an aid, while the student's wishes and abilities remain central. Counseling should not become an outlet for parental anxiety.

Use assessments, data platforms, and AI matching while developing counseling skill and case experience. Progress toward a school counseling center, counseling supervisor role, or independent practice. Move from information provider to in-depth counselor.

People with teaching, human resources, or psychological counseling experience can make a relatively smooth transition. Start with a career-planning or counseling credential, then seek an assistant counselor role at a school or agency. Real cases and communication examples often matter more in interviews than certificates alone.

Do not reduce counselors to information clerks; AI handles that work. Give counselors data tools and manageable caseloads so they can focus on deeper counseling. Supervision and case reviews build professional skill and help retain strong counselors.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Online search for major courses and employment data
Online assessment of interests, personality, and abilities
Online counseling that reaches more students
Automated answers to common education questions

ai_s7_trends: AI takes over information lookup and initial matching while counselors shift to deeper counseling.
Subject-selection reforms and mental health policies continue to increase demand.
Assessment data and AI tools become standard in personalized planning.

body: Educational, Guidance, And Career Counselors And Advisors provide academic planning, subject and college application guidance, career counseling, and psychological support in schools and education organizations. They use assessments and counseling methods to help students understand themselves and make choices.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can clearly list what each major leads to and how much it pays, but only a counselor in the room can hear what lies behind a student's fear whenever science subjects come up.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把每个专业毕业后干什么、工资多少列得清清楚楚，但「这个孩子为什么一提理科就发抖」——这种藏在分数背后的东西，只有坐在咨询室里的人听得见。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年顾问教育在岗约 37.63 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 38.96 万人，净增约 1.33 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.10 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.51 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 正在填平教育与职业规划里的信息差：专业库、职业匹配、薪资数据、选科建议，学生和家长自己就能查到。但规划咨询的本质是「认识自我 + 做选择」——孩子适合什么、焦虑背后是什么、家庭期望和孩子意愿怎么调和，这些需要持续的信任关系和专业判断，AI 能提供数据，给不了方向和温度。
ai_s2_accel: AI 职业匹配引擎提供初步建议
智能问答覆盖常见升学咨询
就业数据看板支撑课程内容
远程咨询平台服务更多学生
ai_s2_auto: 专业与职业信息库在线自助查询
生涯测评与兴趣评估在线化
志愿填报数据工具辅助匹配
咨询记录与报告电子化
ai_s3_list: 个体理解：测评之外的自我认知洞察。
信任关系：让学生愿意说出真实想法。
家庭沟通：调和家长期望与孩子意愿。
综合判断：数据、性格、情境的整合。
持续跟进：选择之后的陪伴与调整。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的「信息与匹配」部分正被 AI 大幅接管，但咨询的核心价值在个体理解、信任关系和选择陪伴上——AI 能告诉你「有这些选项」，却替不了你「认识这个人、陪他做决定」。岗位不会消失，而是从信息提供转向深度咨询。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于没变化：只会背专业库、念就业数据的顾问会被 AI 替代；而会用数据工具、又懂心理和沟通的顾问，反而因为服务更深而更抢手。把 AI 当资料员，把自己当咨询师。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 如果孩子想做教育顾问，建议读教育学、心理学专业，在校多接触咨询与生涯方向。家长也建议理性看待：规划是辅助，孩子的意愿和能力才是核心，别让咨询变成家长的焦虑出口。
把测评工具、数据平台和 AI 匹配用起来，同时深耕咨询技能和个案经验。往学校心理中心、咨询主管或独立执业发展，把「信息型顾问」升级成「深度咨询型」。
有教师、人力资源、心理咨询背景的转行相对顺：先考生涯规划或心理咨询资格，从学校或机构的助理顾问做起。面试展示真实个案和沟通案例，比证书更打动人。
别把顾问岗位压成「信息查询员」，那是 AI 的事。给顾问配置数据工具和合理个案量，让他们专注深度咨询；用督导和案例复盘提升专业度，才能留住好顾问。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 专业课程、就业数据在线检索
兴趣、性格、能力在线评估
咨询记录与跟进一体化
行业与就业趋势可视化
线上咨询覆盖更多学生
常见升学问题自动应答

ai_s7_trends: AI 接管信息查询与初步匹配，顾问转向深度咨询。
新高考选科与心理健康政策推动岗位持续增加。
测评数据与 AI 工具成为个性化规划标配。

body: 教育与职业指导顾问在学校与教育机构中为学生提供学业规划、选科与志愿指导、生涯发展咨询与心理支持，运用测评与咨询方法帮助学生认识自我、做出选择。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Robotic arms can tighten bolts, but an unusual sound during testing or a bad clearance during rework still requires a worker's ears and hands.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 38,400 Engine And Other Machine Assemblers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 30,300 by 2034, a net loss of about 8,100 jobs, with about 2,800 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $52,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and automation will not immediately replace Engine And Other Machine Assemblers, but they will gradually take over repetitive assembly steps. Robotic arms and automated tightening stations expand each year, shifting workers from manual assembly toward human-machine collaboration and test judgment. Alignment, trial runs, fault detection, and rework remain difficult to automate. Assemblers who work with automation and understand commissioning become more secure.
ai_s2_accel: Introduce collaborative robots on assembly lines
Use AI vision to inspect assembly quality
Automate new-energy powertrain lines more extensively
Use digital twins to optimize assembly processes
ai_s2_auto: Scan and register assembly records and work orders
Replace manual torque work with automated tightening stations
Use robotic arms at standardized assembly stations
ai_s3_list: Alignment judgment: people feel clearance and concentricity.
Test-run judgment: people hear unusual sounds and interpret parameters.
Rework diagnosis: people disassemble failed units and find the cause.
Multi-process ability: workers can assemble components or complete machines and cover shortages.
Quality ownership: one incorrectly tightened bolt can compromise the entire machine.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate exposure. Most work occurs on the shop floor, so algorithms standardize only limited desk tasks such as work orders and records.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not guarantee safety. Robotic arms are taking over repetitive assembly steps, making the automated line itself the main source of change. Assemblers who work with robots, understand testing and commissioning, and resolve exceptions become more secure. Jobs limited to tightening bolts are narrowing.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Mechanical, electromechanical, and automotive programs provide a direct path. Prioritize practical training and credentials. Build both fitting and electrical skills to improve prospects during the new-energy transition.

Learn new-energy powertrain assembly, testing, and commissioning. Pursue advanced assembly-fitter and technician credentials. Move from manual assembly toward human-machine collaboration and test judgment, then advance toward commissioning technician roles.

Mechanical or automotive repair experience speeds entry. Start with component assembly. On your résumé, list the machine types you assembled, commissioning tasks you performed, and test-run experience.
Do not hire assemblers for speed alone. Evaluate process discipline and quality awareness. Workers who collaborate with automation, judge test runs, and follow procedures are the scarcest.

ai_s7_trends: Robotic arms and automated tightening stations expand, shifting assemblers from manual work toward human-machine collaboration and test judgment. Automation collaboration becomes a core skill.
The new-energy powertrain transition creates demand. Assemblers who understand battery and electronic-control systems become more sought after.
Digital quality traceability increases the share of work involving MES data.

body: Engine And Other Machine Assemblers build engines, machines, and components into finished products according to process requirements. They verify materials, assemble parts, tighten bolts, adjust alignment, conduct trial runs, and complete rework.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Robotic arms can tighten bolts, but an unusual sound during testing or a bad clearance during rework still requires a worker's ears and hands.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 机械臂能拧螺丝，但试车时那声不对劲的异响、返工时排查的那个间隙，还得靠你的耳朵和手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年发动机和其他机器装配工在岗约 3.84 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.03 万人，岗位净减约 0.81 万个，年均产生约 0.28 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.25 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 和自动化不会立即取代发动机装配工，但会慢慢接手重复装配工序。机械臂与自动拧紧站逐年增加，装配工从「手动装配」转向「人机协作+测试判断」——对正调整、试车检测、异常返修，是机器替代不了的。会配合自动化、懂调试的装配工反而更稳。
ai_s2_accel: 人机协作机器人进装配线
AI 视觉检测装配质量
新能源动力产线自动化程度更高
数字孪生辅助装配工艺优化
ai_s2_auto: 装配记录与工单扫码登记
自动拧紧站替代人工力矩操作
ai_s3_list: 对正调整的手感：间隙、同心度，机器装不出。
试车判断的经验：听声音、看参数，异常靠耳朵。
返工排查的思路：装不上、测不过，拆开找原因。
多工序能力：会部件装、整机装，缺人顶得上。
质量责任心：一颗螺栓没拧对，整机都白搭。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业大部分时间在车间装配，能被算法标准化的桌面动作有限——主要是工单和记录这些边角活。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低分不等于安全。机械臂正在接手重复装配工序，真正的变数是自动化产线本身。会配合机器人、懂测试调试、能处理异常的装配工更稳，纯「拧螺栓」的岗位在收窄。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 机械、机电、汽车专业是正路，重视实训考证。把装配钳工技能和电气知识都练起来，新能源转型期更吃香。
主动学新能源动力装配与测试调试，考高级装配钳工、技师等级。从「手动装配」升级为「人机协作+测试判断」，往调试技师走。
有机械或汽车维修背景上手快，可从部件装配做起。简历多写「装配过哪些机型、会哪些调试、有没有试车经验」。
招装配工别只看速度，要看工艺规范和质量意识。能配合自动化、会试车判断、又守得住工艺的装配工，是最稀缺的。

ai_s7_trends: 机械臂与自动拧紧站普及，装配工从「手动装配」转向「人机协作+测试判断」，自动化协作成为基本功。
新能源动力转型创造新需求，会装新能源动力、懂电池电控的装配工更抢手。
质量追溯数字化，装配工与 MES 数据打交道的比重上升。

body: 发动机与机器装配工负责按工艺要求将发动机、机器及其部件组装为成品，包括领料核对、部件装配、螺栓拧紧、对正调整、整机试运转与返修。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 机械臂能拧螺丝，但试车时那声不对劲的异响、返工时排查的那个间隙，还得靠你的耳朵和手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Layout software can calculate positions, but experienced workers still judge hole depth and align each post with their eyes and measuring tools.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 26,400 Fence Erectors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 27,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,200 jobs, with about 2,300 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $46,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Fence Erectors, but it will accelerate measurement and ordering. Layout software, material calculations, and drawing management reduce administrative work. Fence Erectors shift from marking positions to digging, installation, alignment, field assembly, and safety control. Workers limited to layout and estimates face pressure, while those who set straight posts and lead crews gain value.
ai_s2_accel: AI optimization of post spacing
Intelligent recommendations for terrain adaptation
Construction-safety alerts
Real-time integration with cost estimates
ai_s3_list: Digging and setting posts: people provide the touch.
Vertical alignment: people provide the trained eye.
Field assembly: people assess the terrain.
Safety control: people enforce standards.
Crew leadership: people set the pace.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate AI exposure in this outdoor occupation. Systems accelerate layout and ordering, but people still perform digging, installation, and alignment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure leaves the occupation stable. Layout and material calculations are being replaced, not the work of setting and aligning posts. Workers who lead crews and handle field conditions can become scarcer as productivity rises. People limited to measuring positions face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Entry barriers are low, but skill matters. Practice setting and aligning posts early. As layout-only work declines, develop field and crew-leadership skills.
Advance from helper to a worker who can set posts and lead a crew. Learn drawings and layout software, then pursue contract work.
Emphasize outdoor and alignment experience and list the fence types you have installed. Forepersons value reliability and accuracy.
Do not select workers only for strength. Assess alignment and crew-leadership skills. Skilled workers who protect quality merit higher daily pay.

ai_s7_trends: Infrastructure and residential demand remains stable.
Systems handle layout; people dig and install.
Workers who align posts and lead crews are in greater demand.

body: Fence Erectors follow drawings and terrain to measure and mark layouts, dig holes, set and concrete posts, install mesh panels, rails, and gates, check vertical and horizontal alignment, and complete finishing work.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Layout software can calculate positions, but experienced workers still judge hole depth and align each post with their eyes and measuring tools.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 放线软件能帮你算点位，但坑挖多深、柱怎么校直，还是师傅一眼一尺定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年栅栏搭建工在岗约 2.64 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.76 万人，净增约 0.12 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.23 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.69 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代栅栏工，但会加速测量与下单。放线软件、物料计算和图纸管理把事务提速，栅栏工从「量点位」挪向「挖装、校正、现场拼装、安全把控」。真正被挤掉的是纯放线与算料，会立杆校直能带组的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 优化立柱间距
地形适配的智能建议
施工安全的提醒
成本核算的实时联动
ai_s3_list: 挖坑立杆：手感靠人。
校正垂直：眼准靠人。
现场拼装：地形靠人看。
安全把控：规范靠人守。
带组统筹：节奏靠人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的户外区——放线下单被系统加速，但挖装与校正还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着岗位稳：被替代的是「放线与算料」动作，不是「立杆校正」的岗位。会带组、能扛现场的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只量点位的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这行门槛低但靠手艺，早点练立杆校正。AI 时代纯放线在缩，练现场带组。
从「小工」升级成「能立杆带组」，学图纸和放线软件，争取包工。
突出户外与校正经验，写清跟过哪些类型。工头看重稳和准。
选人别只看力气，要看会不会校正带组。能扛质量的师傅，值得给高日薪。

ai_s7_trends: 基建小区需求稳。
系统替放线，人做挖装。
会带组校正的人更抢手。

body: 栅栏搭建工（Fence Erectors）按图纸与现场地形测量放线，挖坑立杆、浇筑固定，安装网片、横杆与大门，校垂直与水平并做收尾。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 放线软件能帮你算点位，但坑挖多深、柱怎么校直，还是师傅一眼一尺定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Financial AI can produce consolidated statements and cash-flow forecasts in seconds, but Financial managers still decide which investments to approve and which risks the company must absorb.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of Financial managers is projected to rise from about 868,600 in 2024 to 997,400 in 2034. That is a net increase of about 128,800 jobs, with roughly 74,600 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $161,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Financial managers, but it will accelerate accounting and reporting. RPA, finance bots, and analytical models speed up bookkeeping, reconciliation, and statements. Managers are shifting from producing figures to business analysis, financing and investment judgment, risk control, and cross-functional coordination. Pure accounting roles face the most pressure. People who understand the business and make decisions become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Cash-flow forecasting models
AI-assisted risk indicator monitoring
Automated business analysis
Scenario simulation and modeling
ai_s3_list: Financing and investment judgment: people decide.
Risk control: experience matters.
Business coordination: people resolve competing priorities.
Compliance judgment: people interpret boundaries.
Strategic guidance: people decide.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this career in the moderate-high exposure range for accounting operations. Systems absorb bookkeeping and reporting, while people still make decisions and coordinate stakeholders.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high career risk. Automation replaces accounting and routine reporting, not business-finance integration and risk decisions. Financial managers who analyze decisions and coordinate with business teams become scarcer as productivity rises. Managers who only understand accounting face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with an accounting degree and study data analysis and Excel. Pure accounting work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop business-finance skills early.
Move from producing statements to analysis and risk control. Learn financial systems and modeling, and seek FP&A or treasury responsibilities.
Highlight analytical decisions and business coordination experience. Companies value stable managers who understand operations.
Do not hire based only on credentials. Look for the ability to use data in decisions. Managers who can carry financial risk merit strong compensation.

ai_s7_trends: RPA absorbs accounting work, while business-finance integration grows.
Financial AI raises productivity.
Financial managers who understand the business are in greater demand.

body: Financial managers direct corporate financial activities. They lead budgeting, cash-flow management, financing and investment decisions, and risk control. They produce consolidated statements and financial analysis, coordinate with auditors and tax teams, and guide business decisions.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Financial AI can produce consolidated statements and cash-flow forecasts in seconds, but Financial managers still decide which investments to approve and which risks the company must absorb.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 财务 AI 能秒出合并报表预测现金流，但哪笔投资该不该投、哪个风险要兜，还是财务经理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年财务经理在岗约 86.86 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 99.74 万人，净增约 12.88 万个岗位，年均产生约 7.46 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 16.17 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代财务经理，但会加速核算与报告。RPA、财务机器人与分析模型把记账、对账、报表提速，财务经理从「出数」挪向「经营分析、投融资判断、风险把控、业务协同」。真正被挤掉的是纯核算会计，懂业务能决策的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 现金流预测建模
风险指标智能监控
经营分析自动生成
情景模拟与测算
ai_s3_list: 投融资判断：靠人。
风险把控：靠经验。
业务协同：靠扯。
合规拿捏：靠判断。
战略支持：靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的核算区——记账报告被系统吃，但决策与协调还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「核算与常规报告」动作，不是「业财融合与风控决策」的岗位。有分析决策力、能协同业务的财务经理，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会做账的核算型。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 财会本科打底，在校多学数据分析与 Excel。AI 时代纯核算在缩，早点练业财。
从「出报表」升级成「做分析 + 控风险」，学财务系统与建模，争取做 FP&A 或司库。
突出分析决策与业务协同经验。企业看重稳和懂业务。
选人别只看证书，要看会不会用数据帮决策。能扛风险的经理，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: RPA 吃核算，业财融合涨。
财务 AI 普及提效。
懂业务的财务经理更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can remind people to take medicine and record physical signs, but "helping the elderly turn over, talking to him, and understanding his emotions" are all personal tasks that machines cannot do for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that there will be approximately 4,347,700 home health assistants employed in 2024, which is expected to rise to 5,087,500 by 2034, with a net increase of approximately 739,800 positions, an average annual vacancy of approximately 765,800, and a median annual salary of approximately US$34,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace home health assistants: life care is "one-on-one physical labor + emotional companionship", which requires empathy and warmth, and models cannot replace it. AI can help with shift scheduling, medication reminders, and physical sign recording, allowing assistants to run fewer errands and make fewer mistakes, but the service itself cannot be separated from people.
ai_s2_accel: Smart wearable monitoring of vital signs
Home fall detection and alarm
Telehealth consultation assistance
Disability assessment AI assistance tool
ai_s2_auto: Digital shift scheduling and door-to-door dispatch
ai_s3_list: Body care: Turning over, transferring, and bathing.
Emotional companionship: understanding the loneliness and uneasiness of the elderly.
Observation and judgment: subtle changes in physical signs and status.
Communication and coordination: Smoothly connect with family members, nurses, and doctors.
Emergency treatment: handling of emergencies such as falls, choking and coughing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 shows that home health assistants are a care profession with "low AI exposure": process management is digitized, but the core personal care and companionship are highly dependent on people. They are a typical example of "AI helps in the background and people guard the scene", and the risk of short-term replacement is very low.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean there is no threshold: nursing is a licensed industry. If you learn skills such as disability care and rehabilitation accompaniment, and upgrade from a "nanny type" to a "professional care type", the income and service value will be completely different.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This is a career with low academic qualifications and strong employment certainty, and is suitable for children who want to be independent as soon as possible: the training and certification period for caregivers is short, and you need to gain experience first by getting a job; later, you can take the nurse qualification exam or go in the direction of rehabilitation or disability care, and the road will become wider as you go.

Learn skills such as disability care, postoperative care, and rehabilitation training, and take higher-level certificates; at the same time, learn to use nursing apps and smart devices. Once your professionalism is improved, the unit price and order quality will be significantly improved.

Nursing is one of the professions that is resistant to AI replacement, and it is not too late to change careers at the age of 40. It is recommended to take the nursing care certificate first and start with a single job from an institution or platform; highlight patience, care experience and emergency handling cases during the interview.

The nursing staff shortage is large and the turnover is fast. Retaining nursing staff relies on "insurance + skill classification + promotion channels": setting salary based on skill classification and allowing outstanding assistants to work as disabled caregivers and nursing supervisors is more cost-effective than constantly recruiting new people.

ai_s6_tools.工具: blood pressure monitor blood glucose meter

ai_s7_trends: As the population ages, the demand for home care continues to grow.
Disability and rehabilitation care are professionalized, and skills determine income.
Smart devices enter the home, and nursing records are fully digitized.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代家庭健康助理：生活照护是「一对一的身体劳动 + 情感陪伴」，需要共情和温度，模型替代不了。AI 能帮的是排班、用药提醒、体征记录，让助理少跑腿、少出错，但服务本身离不开人。
ai_s2_accel: 智能穿戴监测生命体征
居家跌倒检测与报警
远程健康咨询辅助
失能评估 AI 辅助工具

ai_s3_list: 身体照护：翻身、转移、洗浴的手上功夫。
情绪陪伴：读懂老人的孤独与不安。
观察判断：体征与状态的细微变化。
沟通协调：跟家属、护士、医生顺畅对接。
应急处理：跌倒、呛咳等突发处置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明家庭健康助理是「低 AI 曝光」的照护职业：流程管理被数字化，但核心的贴身照护与陪伴高度依赖人，是「AI 帮后台，人守现场」的典型，短期被替代风险很低。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没门槛：护理是持证行业，把失能照护、康复陪护这些技能学起来，从「保姆型」升级成「专业照护型」，收入和服务价值都完全不同。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这是学历门槛低、就业确定性强的职业，适合想早点独立的孩子：护理员培训考证周期短，先就业积累经验；后续可考护士资格或往康复、失能照护方向走，路越走越宽。
把失能照护、术后陪护、康复训练这些技能学起来，考更高等级证书；同时学会用护理 App 和智能设备，专业度提升后单价和接单质量都会明显改善。
护理是抗 AI 替代的职业之一，40 岁上下转行也来得及。建议先考养老护理员证书，从机构或平台单量做起；面试时突出耐心、照护经验和紧急情况处理案例。
护理员缺口大、流失快，留人靠「保险 + 技能分级 + 晋升通道」：给技能分级定薪，让优秀助理往失能照护师、护理督导走，比不断招新人划算。

ai_s7_trends: 老龄化加深，居家照护需求持续增长。
失能与康复照护专业化，技能决定收入。
智能设备进家门，护理记录全面数字化。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 301,400 loan officers employed in 2024, projected to reach 306,500 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 5,100 jobs, with roughly 20,300 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $74,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace loan officers, but it will reshape their workflow by assigning repetitive, structured tasks to tools and leaving judgment, accountability, and creativity to people. Use collaboration tools to accelerate cross-team lending coordination.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate every rehabilitation assessment score, but a rehabilitation physician still has to see and personally encourage the patient who took two more steps today than yesterday.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 340,700 physical medicine and rehabilitation physicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 349,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 8,600 jobs, with about 9,600 openings annually and a 2024 median annual salary of ≥$239,200 (highest BLS OES bracket, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace rehabilitation physicians, but it will change assessment. Where clinicians once relied on manual examinations and scale scores, AI gait analysis, EMG monitoring, and rehabilitation robots now make assessment and training more precise. Physical examination, goal setting, and deep patient communication still depend on people. AI gives a functional score, but a physician decides what goal the patient can realistically reach.
ai_s2_accel: Robot-assisted rehabilitation training: exoskeletons and robotic arms assist training according to prescriptions
AI personalized plan recommendations: recommend training intensity and frequency from assessment data
Remote monitoring with wearables: home-training data returns for real-time plan adjustments
Virtual-reality rehabilitation training: immersive task training improves adherence
ai_s2_auto: Digital rehabilitation assessment scales: automatically calculate strength, balance, and ADL scores
AI gait and posture analysis: automatically identify abnormal gait and compensation patterns
Electronic rehabilitation records: systematize progress notes, prescriptions, and follow-up reminders
Imaging-assisted assessment: MRI/CT automatically labels function-related structures
ai_s3_list: Physical examination and functional judgment: machines cannot replace the feel of muscle tone and joint range of motion under a clinician's hands.
Rehabilitation goal setting: experience and judgment define a reachable goal for each patient.
Patient communication and motivation: people persuade patients to continue when they want to give up.
Multidisciplinary coordination: physicians lead the integration of neurology, orthopedics, nursing, and rehabilitation therapy.
Boundaries in clinical decisions: people decide when to increase training and when to refer for surgery.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 means that half of the tasks involve standardized assessment and plan development, which AI and rehabilitation equipment accelerate. AI can only assist the core work of physical examination, communication, and goal setting.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. Stronger AI increases the need for rehabilitation physicians who understand assessment, set goals, lead teams, and provide oversight. AI supplies scores and recommendations, but people judge how far training should go and what happens next. Entry-level functions limited to routine prescriptions face pressure, while physicians who conduct data-driven assessment and lead comprehensive rehabilitation become scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with a bachelor's degree in clinical medicine and choose rehabilitation during residency. Rehabilitation medicine develops slowly but faces a large shortage, with long-term demand supported by aging. Physicians who assess well and use rehabilitation equipment are more sought after in the AI era, so study rehabilitation medicine and neurology early.

Use AI assessment tools and rehabilitation robots, investing the saved time in subspecialties such as neurological, musculoskeletal, or cardiopulmonary rehabilitation. Move beyond routine prescriptions toward data-driven, personalized plans.

A medical background provides an advantage. Earn rehabilitation medicine physician credentials before entering the specialty. Rehabilitation therapists face a lengthy path to becoming physicians and can start in therapy while planning. Quantify outcomes on your resume, such as patients managed and functional improvement rates.

When hiring rehabilitation physicians, assess evaluation ability and communication, not only professional title. Candidates who lead rehabilitation teams, use smart equipment, and withstand long-term care pressure deserve more investment than those with academic credentials alone.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Gait parameter analysis and compensation-pattern recognition
Home-training data return and exception alerts
Recommend intensity and frequency from assessment data
Visualized muscle activation and training feedback
Consultation records and rehabilitation team collaboration

ai_s7_trends: Aging and high chronic disease prevalence continue increasing rehabilitation demand, with clear shortages in neurological and musculoskeletal rehabilitation and insufficient physician supply.
AI assessment and rehabilitation robots become standard, shifting physicians toward plan development, goal setting, and team management.
As the three-tier rehabilitation system improves, services extend into communities and homes, making remote rehabilitation monitoring routine.

body: Physical medicine and rehabilitation physicians use functional assessment, physical therapy, rehabilitation training, and assistive devices to help patients with disease- or injury-related impairments regain movement, independence, and social participation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate every rehabilitation assessment score, but a rehabilitation physician still has to see and personally encourage the patient who took two more steps today than yesterday.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出康复评估的各项分数，但「今天比昨天多走了两步」这件事，还得康复医师亲眼看着、亲手鼓励。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年物理医学与康复医师在岗约 34.07 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 34.93 万人，净增约 0.86 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.96 万个职位空缺，2024 年中位数年薪 ≥$239,200（BLS OES 最高档，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代康复医师，但会改变「评估」的姿势。以前靠人工查体和量表打分，现在有 AI 步态分析、肌电监测、康复机器人辅助训练，评估和训练更精细。可查体、定目标、与患者深度沟通这些核心，还得靠人——AI 告诉你功能分数，但「怎么定一个患者够得着的目标」，是医生的判断。
ai_s2_accel: 康复机器人辅助训练：外骨骼、机械臂按处方辅助训练
AI 个性化方案推荐：按评估数据推荐训练强度与频次
可穿戴设备远程监测：居家训练数据回传实时调方案
虚拟现实康复训练：沉浸式任务训练提升依从性
ai_s2_auto: 康复评估量表数字化：肌力、平衡、ADL 评分自动计算
AI 步态与姿势分析：自动识别异常步态与代偿模式
康复记录电子化：病程、处方、随访提醒系统化
影像辅助评估：MRI/CT 自动标注功能相关结构
ai_s3_list: 查体与功能判断：手上摸到的肌张力、关节活动度，机器替代不了。
康复目标设定：给每个患者定一个「够得着」的目标，是经验加判断。
医患沟通与激励：患者练到想放弃时，怎么把他说服回来，靠人。
多学科协调：神经、骨科、护理、康复治疗师的整合，是医生来牵头。
临床决策的边界感：什么时候该加量、什么时候该转手术，要人拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半任务在标准化评估和方案制定上——这些正被 AI 和康复设备加速，但查体、沟通、目标设定这些核心，AI 只能辅助。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 越强，越需要懂评估、会定目标、能带团队的康复医师去把关——它给你分数和方案建议，但「练到什么程度、下一步怎么办」要人判断。真正被挤压的是「只开常规处方」的初级职能，会数据化评估、能主导综合康复的医师反而更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 临床医学本科起步，规培时选康复方向。康复医学是「慢热但缺口大」的专科，老龄化背景下的需求长期确定。AI 时代，会评估、会用康复设备的医生更吃香，建议在校就接触康复医学和神经科。
把 AI 评估工具和康复机器人用起来，省下的时间花在亚方向深耕上（神经、骨关节、心肺康复）。别停留在「开常规康复处方」，往数据化、个性化方案走，才跟得上。
医学背景转康复有优势，可先考康复医学执业医师再进专科；康复治疗师转医生路径长，可从治疗师岗切入再规划。简历上写「管理患者数、功能改善率」这类可量化成果。
招康复医师别只看职称，要看评估能力和沟通。能带康复团队、会用智能康复设备、扛得住长期照护压力的候选人，比单纯学术背景的人更值得投入。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 步态参数分析、代偿模式识别
肌力/平衡/ADL 评分自动化
外骨骼、机械臂按处方训练
居家训练数据回传、异常提醒
沉浸式任务、依从性提升
按评估数据推荐强度频次
肌肉激活可视化、训练反馈
会诊记录、康复团队协同

ai_s7_trends: 老龄化与慢病高发推动康复需求持续上升，神经康复、骨关节康复缺口明显，康复医师供不应求。
AI 评估与康复机器人成为标配，医师重心转向方案制定、目标设定与团队管理。
三级康复体系逐步完善，康复向社区与居家延伸，远程康复监测成为常规服务。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Laser cutters can cut stock automatically and CNC brakes can bend by program, but experienced workers still lay out complex parts, adjust pieces that do not fit on site, and hammer the right curve.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 127,000 sheet metal workers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 130,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,100 jobs, with about 10,600 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $60,800 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and automation will not immediately replace sheet metal workers, but they will change the work. Laser cutting, CNC bending, and nesting software are taking over cutting and standard bending, shifting workers from manual calculation and cutting toward programming, setup, hand finishing, and field installation. Complex layout, welding skill, and on-site adjustment remain irreplaceable.
ai_s2_accel: Wider use of flexible sheet metal lines
Robotic bending and welding
3D scanning for reverse modeling
Digital workshop management
ai_s3_list: Complex-part layout: spatial skill determines how irregular parts unfold and form.
Manual hammer forming: people create curved surfaces and hems machines cannot.
Welding and joining: strong, smooth seams require hands-on skill.
On-site installation adjustment: experience resolves field dimensional deviations.
Equipment and material experience: people know which material and process to use.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means some repetitive processing is becoming digital. Software and CNC equipment assist with cutting and standard bending.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure still carries risk. CNC equipment replaces some manual cutting and bending, but complex parts, field installation, and welding remain human-led. Workers limited to basic handwork should worry; those who use CNC, read drawings, and install are more secure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Choose sheet metal or CNC studies at a technical or vocational high school rather than focusing only on credentials. Practice drawing reading, CNC programming, and welding together, and intern at an equipment factory or ventilation installer.

Learn laser cutting and CNC press-brake programming and seek complex parts and field installations. Advance from operator to combined sheet metal technician + CNC specialist and obtain welding credentials.
Career changers can begin as sheet metal apprentices and learn flat-pattern calculations and bending. On resumes, list equipment, products, and field installation experience.
Do not hire only for manual ability; assess drawing skills and willingness to learn. Versatile workers who program, fabricate by hand, and install merit high pay.

ai_s7_trends: Laser cutting and CNC bending are spreading, shifting work from manual cutting and bending toward programming and setup + hand finishing + field installation. CNC skills are becoming standard.
Demand from building ventilation and equipment manufacturing remains stable, while workers skilled in custom complex parts and field installation are scarcer.
Robotic bending and flexible lines are being piloted, shifting workers toward combined equipment maintenance + process programming roles.

body: Sheet metal workers mark, cut, bend, form, join, and install sheet metal from drawings to produce ducts, enclosures, and structural parts. They are a key skilled trade in building ventilation, metal products, and equipment manufacturing.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 激光切割机能自动下料、数控折弯机能按程序折弯，但复杂件的放样、现场装不上的调整、敲出来的那道弧线，还得靠老师傅。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年钣金工在岗约 12.70 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 13.01 万人，净增约 0.31 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.06 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.08 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 和自动化不会立刻取代钣金工，但会改变工作方式。激光切割、数控折弯、套料软件正在接走下料和标准折弯环节，钣金工从「动手算、动手切」转向「编程、调机、手工精修、现场安装」。复杂件放样、焊接手艺和现场调整，是机器替代不了的核心。
ai_s2_accel: 钣金柔性生产线普及
机器人折弯与焊接应用
3D 扫描逆向建模辅助
数字化车间管理覆盖
ai_s3_list: 复杂件放样：异形件怎么展开、怎么成型，靠空间感。
手工敲打成型：弧面、包边，机器做不出的曲线。
焊接与连接手艺：焊缝结实、外观平整，靠手上功夫。
现场安装调整：工地尺寸有偏差，靠经验现场解决。
设备与材料的经验：什么料、什么工艺，心里有数。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业有一部分重复加工环节正在被数字化——下料、标准折弯，软件和数控设备都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于零风险。数控设备确实会替代一部分手工下料和折弯，但复杂件、现场安装和焊接依然靠人。真正该担心的是「只会基础手工」，会数控、懂图纸、能安装的钣金工更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走技校或职高的钣金、数控专业，别只看学历。把看图、数控编程和焊接一起练，实习去设备厂或通风安装公司。
把激光切割、数控折弯编程学起来，主动接复杂件和现场安装。从「操作工」升级为「钣金技师+数控复合」，考焊工等证书。
可从钣金学徒切入，学展开计算和折弯。简历上多写「会哪些设备、做过什么产品、有没有现场安装经验」。
招钣金工别只看会干活，要看图纸能力和学习意愿。能编程、能手工、能安装的复合钣金工，值得高薪留。

ai_s7_trends: 激光切割与数控折弯普及，钣金工从「手工下料折弯」转向「编程调机+手工精修+现场安装」，数控技能成为标配。
建筑通风与设备制造需求稳定，复杂件定制和现场安装的钣金师傅更稀缺。
机器人折弯与柔性产线试点，钣金工向「设备运维+工艺编程」复合角色转变。

body: 钣金工根据图纸对金属板材进行划线、剪切、折弯、成型、连接与安装，制作风管、箱体、结构件等钣金产品，是建筑通风、金属制品与设备制造行业的关键技术工种。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI speech assistants can help people practice pronunciation, but adapting in the moment to individual needs, such as noticing that someone is having a bad day and will speak if the activity changes, still requires a trainer.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 109,700 speech-language pathology assistants were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 113,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,800 jobs, with approximately 14,400 openings annually. Median annual pay in 2026 is about $46,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace speech-language pathology assistants, but it will divert simple training tasks. Pronunciation practice apps and AI speech assessment can already handle routine exercises for mild cases, while moderate and severe cases require in-person demonstrations, oral-motor techniques, emotional reassurance, and immediate feedback. AI cannot provide these face-to-face interactions. Assistants will shift from maximizing practice volume to providing precisely targeted support.
ai_s2_accel: AI speech recognition to assess training outcomes
Automatic generation of personalized training materials
Online telepractice platforms
Smart devices for swallowing and oral-motor training
ai_s2_auto: Digital library of teaching aids and materials
ai_s3_list: In-person observation: Assessing a person's condition through facial expressions and movements.
Interactive adjustment: Turning repetitive exercises into games.
Oral-motor techniques: Supporting swallowing and articulation exercises.
Emotional support: Encouraging patients to keep trying to speak.
Home-school communication: Helping parents support training at home.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates that speech-language pathology assistants are a rehabilitation occupation with moderately high AI exposure. Pronunciation assessment, material generation, and recordkeeping are digitizing quickly, but delivering training requires face-to-face physical interaction. AI can only support the surrounding tasks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure is a warning not to become merely a human practice robot. Learn to interpret assessment data, adjust training plans, and explain progress to parents. When AI serves as your data assistant instead of your rival, your value no longer rests on repetitive drills.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For a fast route into rehabilitation, pursue an associate degree in speech therapy or rehabilitation therapy. Complete multiple clinical internships during college and gain experience with varied case types. Build a strong foundation in speech anatomy and child development psychology instead of treating the job as simply playing with children.

Professional certification is essential. Prepare for speech-language therapist licensure and build specialized experience in articulation, stuttering, swallowing, and other case types. Use AI assessment tools for data-driven management so that training results are visible.

A background in early childhood education, nursing, or special education gives career changers an advantage. Start as a therapy assistant to learn the workflow. In interviews, emphasize patience, a clear speaking voice, and rapport with children. Clearly explaining how you would lead a training session is a plus.

Rehabilitation organizations do not simply lack therapists; they lack stable implementation teams. Create a pathway for assistants that combines training, certification subsidies, and promotion to therapist roles. This can significantly reduce turnover. Do not treat assistants as disposable labor.

ai_s7_trends: Demand for pediatric speech and stuttering intervention continues to grow, with increasingly diverse case types.
AI speech assessment is entering routine training, making data-driven practice standard.
Licensed therapists remain in short supply, strengthening advancement opportunities and pay for assistants.

body: Speech-language pathology assistants carry out rehabilitation exercises for pronunciation, language, swallowing, and related needs under the supervision of a speech-language pathologist. They prepare teaching aids and record training data and progress, serving as implementation and support members of the therapy team.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 语音助手能陪人练发音，但「他今天状态不好、换个玩法就开口了」这种因人而异的现场调节，还得靠训练师。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年语言助理在岗约 10.97 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 11.35 万人，净增约 0.38 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.44 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.61 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代语言治疗助理，但会分流简单训练：发音练习 App、AI 语音评测已经能承担轻度个案的日常练习；而中重度个案需要现场示范、口肌操作、情绪安抚和即时反馈，这些面对面的互动，AI 做不了。助理会从「练得多」变成「陪得准」。
ai_s2_accel: AI 语音识别评测训练效果
个性化训练材料自动生成
线上远程训练平台
吞咽与口肌训练智能设备
ai_s2_auto: 排课与预约管理自动化
教具与素材数字资源库
ai_s3_list: 现场观察：从表情动作判断状态。
互动调节：把枯燥训练变成游戏。
口肌手法：吞咽与构音辅助操作。
情感陪伴：鼓励患者坚持开口。
家校沟通：让家长在家配合训练。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明语言助理是「中高曝光」的康复岗位：发音评测、材料生成、记录这些环节数字化快，但训练执行是面对面的身体互动，AI 只能补外围。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光提醒你别只做「陪练机器人」：把评测数据读明白、会调整训练方案、能跟家长解释进度，让 AI 当你的数据助手而不是对手，你的价值就不在重复训练上。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入行康复，专科的言语治疗/康复治疗专业是捷径，大学期间多去诊所实习、攒个案类型。把发音解剖和儿童发展心理学学扎实，别只想着陪玩。
往持证走是硬道理：备考言语治疗师执照，积累构音、口吃、吞咽等专长个案。同时用 AI 评测工具做数据化管理，让训练效果看得见。
幼教、护理、特教背景转岗有优势，先从治疗助理做起熟悉流程；面试时强调耐心、声音条件和对孩子的亲和力，能把「带练一节课」讲明白就加分。
康复机构缺的不是治疗师数量，是稳定的执行团队。给助理设计「培训 + 考证补贴 + 晋升治疗师」的路径，能明显降低流失率，别把助理当耗材用。

ai_s7_trends: 儿童言语与口吃干预需求持续增长，个案类型更多元。
AI 语音评测进入日常训练，数据化训练成为标配。
持证治疗师缺口大，助理晋升通道和薪资水涨船高。

body: 语言治疗助理在言语语言病理治疗师的指导下，执行发音、语言、吞咽等康复训练，准备教具、记录训练数据与进展，是治疗团队中的执行与支持角色。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 语音助手能陪人练发音，但「他今天状态不好、换个玩法就开口了」这种因人而异的现场调节，还得靠训练师。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Sorting lines can route goods automatically, but order fillers still decide which item is damaged, which storage location is wrong, and when a rush order needs priority.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 2,764,800 stockers and order fillers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 2,999,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 235,000 jobs, with approximately 472,300 openings annually. Median annual pay in 2026 is about $37,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace stockers and order fillers as a whole, but it will sharply reduce standardized roles. Automated storage and retrieval systems, sorting robots, and conveyor lines are taking over putaway and picking, shifting human time toward exception handling, cross-docking, and on-site scheduling. Workers who only walk routes and scan goods face displacement, while those who can use systems and resolve exceptions become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Computer vision inventory counts for reconciliation
Smart alerts for order exceptions
Route optimization for greater efficiency
Digital training simulations
ai_s2_auto: Automated storage and retrieval systems and goods-to-person fulfillment
ai_s3_list: Exception handling: People identify damage and misplaced goods.
Cross-dock scheduling: People prioritize rush orders.
Inventory discrepancies: People investigate the cause.
Equipment backup: People intervene when robots get stuck.
End-to-end coordination: Connecting putaway, picking, and shipping.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 indicates that this occupation has moderately high AI exposure in warehousing and distribution. Robots can replace much standardized picking, but people retain a role in exception handling and scheduling.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces standardized movement, not the entire occupation. People who can use systems and resolve exceptions become scarcer as automation expands. The real risk is knowing only how to scan goods and refusing to learn the systems.

ai_s5_persona.建议: With a high school education, focus on practicing with systems and equipment. AI is taking over routine travel, so learn exception handling and system use early.
Advance from scanning goods to managing exceptions and using systems. Learn to work across multiple zones and equipment types, then pursue a team lead role.
Highlight accuracy and systems experience, and specify which warehouse zones you have worked in. WMS experience is preferred.
Do not recruit solely for speed. Evaluate accuracy and systems skills. Order fillers who can resolve exceptions and protect fulfillment performance deserve higher performance pay.

ai_s7_trends: Automated storage and sorting robots continue to eliminate standardized roles.
Exception handling and cross-docking are receiving greater attention.
Multi-zone order fillers who can use systems are in higher demand.

body: Stockers and order fillers receive and put away goods, replenish shelves, and pick and verify orders in warehouses, distribution centers, and retail backrooms. They operate handheld terminals and conveyor and sorting equipment to maintain inventory accuracy and fulfill orders on time.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Sorting lines can route goods automatically, but order fillers still decide which item is damaged, which storage location is wrong, and when a rush order needs priority.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 分拣线能自动分货，但哪件破损、哪个库位错了、急单要插队，还得拣货员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年补货与订单拣货员在岗约 276.48 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 299.98 万人，净增约 23.50 万个岗位，年均产生约 47.23 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.71 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会整体取代补货与订单拣货员，但会大幅压缩标准岗。自动立库、分拣机器人和输送线把上架拣选接走了，人的时间转向异常处理、越库和现场调度。真正被挤掉的是只会走位扫货的操作工，会用系统、能处置异常的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 视觉盘点辅助对账
异常订单智能预警
路径优化提效
数字培训仿真
ai_s3_list: 异常处理：破损错库靠人。
越库调度：急单靠人插。
盘点差异：原因靠人查。
设备补位：机器人卡住靠人。
综合协调：把上拣发串起来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的仓配区——大量标准拣选能被机器人替代，但异常与调度还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准走位」，不是「岗位」。会用系统、能处置异常的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。怕的是只会扫货、不学系统的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 高中起步多练系统和设备。AI 时代走位被接走，早点练异常和系统。
从「扫货」升级成「管异常 + 用系统」，学多区多设备，争取转组长。
突出准确率和系统经验，写清跑过哪些区。有WMS经验优先。
招人别只看快，看准确和系统。能处置异常、保履约的拣货员值得更高绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 自动立库与分拣机器人继续吃标准岗。
异常处理与越库更受重视。
会用系统的多区拣货员更抢手。

body: 补货与订单拣货员在仓库、配送中心与零售后区负责货物接收上架、货架补货、按订单拣选与复核，操作手持终端与输送分拣设备，保障库存准确与订单准时履约。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can lay out an entire room's grout-line plan in one minute, but a craftsperson's hands and eyes still determine whether a cut will chip the tile and whether a piece will lie flat.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 52,600 tile and stone setters were employed in 2024, with employment projected to rise to 58,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 5,400 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 4,200 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $52,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace tile and stone setters. Installation is inherently hands-on and site-specific, with different substrates, moisture levels, and irregular shapes that machines cannot standardize. AI and CNC equipment assist with quantity calculations, layouts, cutting, and color recommendations, but technique, flatness, and responsibility remain entirely in the craftsperson's hands.
ai_s2_accel: Laser levels and infrared layout tools improve efficiency
Suction lifters and powered handling equipment for large-format sintered slabs
Adoption of thin-set methods and standardized mortar
3D scanning assists layout in irregular spaces
ai_s2_auto: Tile layout and quantity apps calculate automatically
CNC waterjet cutters and cutting machines provide precision fabrication
Grout color matching and effect-preview tools
Material inventory and delivery progress management
ai_s3_list: Installation technique: experience determines mortar thickness and tapping force.
Flatness control: correct tile height and align all four corners on site.
Irregular-shape work: measure and cut internal and external corners and pipe openings on site.
Substrate assessment: know how to respond when moisture or flatness fails requirements.
Responsibility: follow standards even in concealed areas and leave no hidden defects.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates that tile installation is an on-site trade with low automation penetration. AI and equipment assist with layout, cutting, and material calculations, but installation itself relies on human technique and judgment and cannot be automated in the near term.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not justify complacency. Large-format sintered slabs and thin-set methods are changing the craft, and workers skilled with new equipment, new materials, and premium processes earn higher rates. Craftspeople who cling to old methods will see high-end orders shift to a younger generation.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For a young person who is not academically inclined, learning a trade is a practical route, and masonry is especially scarce and often becomes more valuable with experience. Attend a reputable vocational school or apprentice with a craftsperson, master basic installation first, then learn newer methods such as large-format sintered slabs. Do not settle for being a helper.

Move into premium processes. Large-format slab installation, dry-hung stone cladding, and thin-set methods command much higher rates than traditional tiling. Protect your knees and back with knee pads, supports, and other tools because a long craft career depends on your body.

Tile setting has a short learning cycle and quick results, suiting people who want to acquire a trade quickly. Spend six months to one year building fundamentals with an experienced worker, then learn layout and quantity apps before taking independent jobs. Build a personal reputation for clean work with little rework, and orders will follow.

The age gap among masons is severe. Retain skilled workers through long-term contracts, technical training, and craft-based rates. Equip them with infrared layout tools and large-slab suction lifters to improve efficiency and safety. Good tools help retain good craftspeople.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatically calculate tile quantities and layout plans
Safe handling and installation of sintered slabs
Improve color matching and installation efficiency
Knee, back, dust, and noise protection

ai_s7_trends: Large-format sintered slabs and thin-set methods are spreading, upgrading traditional tile installation toward premium processes.
The age gap among masons is widening, and skilled workers who know newer processes remain scarce.
Digital layout and quantity calculations are becoming standard, while on-site installation still depends on people.

body: Tile and stone setters install tile and stone on interior and exterior floors and walls. Their work includes substrate preparation, layout, material cutting, setting and fastening, grouting and cleaning, and finished-surface protection, making this a core hands-on trade in decoration and renovation.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一分钟排好整个房间的砖缝方案，但「这一刀切下去会不会崩瓷、这一块贴下去平不平」，得靠师傅的手和眼。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年瓷砖和石材铺设工在岗约 5.26 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.80 万人，净增约 0.54 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.42 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.22 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代瓷砖和石材铺设工：铺贴是典型的现场手工作业，基层、湿度和异形每处都不同，机器标准化不了。AI 和数控设备能帮忙的是算量排版、切割加工和配色建议，真正的功夫——手法、平整度、责任心——全在师傅手上。
ai_s2_accel: 激光水平仪与红外放线提效
大板岩板吸盘与电动搬运设备
薄贴法与标准化胶浆推广
3D 扫描辅助异形空间放样
ai_s2_auto: 瓷砖排版与算量 App 自动计算
数控水刀与切割机精准加工
美缝配色与效果预览工具
材料库存与送货进度管理
ai_s3_list: 铺贴手法：浆料薄厚、敲击力度的经验积累。
平整把控：砖面高低、四角齐平的现场校正。
异形处理：阴阳角、管道口的现场切割放样。
基层判断：湿度、平整度不合格时知道怎么处理。
责任心：隐蔽部位也按标准做，不留隐患。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明瓷砖铺贴是「低自动化渗透」的现场工种：AI 和设备能辅助排版、切割、算料，但铺贴作业本身依赖人的手法和判断，短期内无法被机器替代。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于可以躺平：大板岩板和薄贴法正在改变工艺，会用新设备、新材料、会做高端工艺的师傅单价更高；只守着老一套的师傅，会看着高端订单流向年轻一代。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 如果孩子不是读书的料，学门手艺是务实的出路，瓦工尤其是「越老越吃香」的稀缺工种。建议走正规技校或拜师，先学基础铺贴再学大板岩板等新工艺，别只满足于当小工。
往高端工艺转型：大板岩板铺贴、石材干挂、薄贴法的单价远超传统铺砖。同时注意保护膝盖和腰，用护膝、支架等工具，手艺做久要靠身体撑。
学瓦工周期短、见效快，适合想快速掌握一门手艺的人。先跟师傅干半年到一年打基础，出师后接单前学会用排版算量 App；把「返工少、活干净」做成个人标签，单子自然来。
瓦工断层严重，建议用「长期合同 + 技能培训 + 按手艺定价」绑定好师傅。给师傅配红外放线、大板吸盘等工具提升效率和安全性，好工具能留住好手艺。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 自动算砖量与排版方案

ai_s7_trends: 大板岩板与薄贴法普及，传统铺贴工艺向高端化升级。
瓦工年龄断层加剧，手艺好、会新工艺的师傅持续稀缺。
排版算量数字化成为标配，现场施工仍靠人手。

body: 瓷砖和石材铺设工负责建筑室内外地面、墙面的瓷砖与石材铺设，包括基层处理、放线排版、材料切割、铺贴固定、填缝清洁与成品保护，是装饰装修中的核心手工作业工种。
